messages.author: 5f75ed225fe8c64c
messages.subject: na31 x na33
parts:
Hello, I've just downloaded the csv version na33 from affymetrix, and in the CRMAv2 method it says I need ufl and ugp files, but they are based on the na31 version. Do you know where to find or how can I build these files from version na33.

Thanks for the attention

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] na31 x na33
parts:
Hi,

I'm not sure which chip type you're working on, but if it is
GenomeWideSNP_6, I've just made the na33 (hg19, dbSNP 137) UGP and UFL
annotation data files available:

http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6

The script used to build these files are:

https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/pkg/aroma.affymetrix/inst/buildScripts/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/?root=aroma-dots

/Henrik
